fit_gpu: Fits in your graphics card: fast.
fit_moe: The graphics card and RAM share the model: since few parameters work on each word, it stays fast.
fit_ram_phone: Runs on the phone's processor: slow, but it answers.
fit_ram: Runs on the processor: slower than with a graphics card.
fit_heavy: Heavy for this machine: very slow.
engine_down_title: The model engine is not responding
engine_down_text: llama.cpp, which runs the models, is not responding: AIODOS restarts it on its own. Try again in a moment.
ollama_down_phone: Ollama runs the models on the phone: restart AIODOS from its app, which starts Ollama along with the node, then try again.
ollama_down_text: Ollama runs the models: start it (or install it from ollama.com), then try again. AIODOS finds it on its own.
all_installed: The recommended models are already installed.
title: Install a model
intro: Recommended models for {device}, with open licenses.
download_hf: The file comes from Hugging Face and is checked before being put in place; you can keep using AIODOS meanwhile.
download_hf_phone: The file comes from Hugging Face and is checked before being put in place (preferably over Wi-Fi: several hundred MB); you can keep using AIODOS meanwhile.
download_ollama: The download goes through Ollama; you can keep using AIODOS meanwhile.
download_ollama_phone: The download goes through Ollama (preferably over Wi-Fi: several hundred MB); you can keep using AIODOS meanwhile.
about_qwen35_0_8b: The lightest: fits on a phone, for simple answers.
about_qwen35_2b: Light and decent: a recent phone, or a small PC.
about_qwen35_4b: A good balance: a graphics card with 4 to 6 GB, or 16 GB of memory.
about_qwen35_9b: The best for an 8 GB graphics card (the model AIODOS recommends).
about_mistral_7b: Mistral AI, good in French: a 6 GB card, or 16 GB of memory.
about_phi4_mini: Microsoft: sharp at reasoning, weaker in French.
about_gemma4_e4b: Google: sharp, sees images, good in French; an 8 GB graphics card.
about_qwen36_35b_a3b: The most capable: a mixture of experts with 35 billion parameters, 3 billion of which work on each word. It needs 32 GB of RAM.
about_embeddinggemma: Indexes your libraries so you can search them: essential for them, and very light.
not_offered: This model is not offered here.
